start.title: What do you want to analyze?
start.subtitle: Import a CAD file or pick a template. The case opens with settings that solve as they are.
start.tip: Tip: press {key} to search commands anytime.
ai.title: AI assistant
ai.lead: AI assistants such as Claude can drive this case through MCP. Their changes appear here instantly so you can review them.
ai.step1: Open your AI client's MCP configuration file.
ai.step2: Add the snippet below and replace <path> with your NovaSolver Studio folder.
ai.step3: Restart the client and ask, e.g. “Create a cantilever beam and solve it.”
ai.note: The AI never writes solver input files. It edits the case schema only, and reports results after checking they are verified.
results.stale: Inputs changed — these results are out of date
results.verifiedNotSafe: “Verified” only means the model matches its reference — it does not mean the part is safe.
run.engineMissing: No engine is installed for this mode. Install one or use Preview.
ai.step2filled: Add the snippet below (it already contains this PC's folder).
import.title: Import a CAD file
import.subtitle: STEP, IGES, BREP or STL (in mm) up to 200 MB. You can also drag a file onto this window.
import.needsBackend: Importing CAD needs the Studio backend
import.formats: .step .stp .iges .igs .brep .stl (STL in mm) up to 200 MB. Opens as a new case.
import.badType: This file type cannot be imported. Supported: {ext}
bc.mixedRoles: The selected faces have different roles. Choosing one applies it to all.
bc.mixedValues: Values differ. Typing applies to all selected faces.
geometry.importedHint: Imported shapes have no editable dimensions. Set conditions per face in the Boundaries step.
verify.title: Reference
verify.noRefShape: This shape has no analytic solution, so “Verified” cannot be judged directly.
run.flowOnlyFinal: Flow on an imported shape runs only as a final OpenFOAM job. It takes a few minutes.
import.as.external: Drag and lift on a body placed in air or water
run.externalOnlyFinal: Flow around a body is solved only by the OpenFOAM final run. It takes several minutes.
flow.title: Flow
flow.directionHint: Flows toward {dir}. The arrow in the 3D view shows it.
bc.external.title: Body surface
bc.external.body: Every face of the body is a wall (no slip). The inlet, outlet and sides are created automatically.
bc.external.size: A box 5 L upstream, 10 L downstream and 5 L to each side, where L is the body size.
job.waiting: Waiting for another job to finish
conv.title: Mesh convergence
conv.checkHint: Solves on coarse, normal and fine meshes and estimates the discretisation error (GCI) from how the answer changes. Takes about 3× a normal run.
conv.noRef: This shape has no analytic solution. Checking mesh convergence shows the answer does not depend on the mesh, and completes “Verified”.
conv.extra: Besides the reference, you can also confirm that the answer does not depend on the mesh.
conv.pass: Refining the mesh barely changes the answer.
conv.notYetBody: The answer still changes with the mesh. Refine the mesh (especially for shapes with small details) to reduce the error.
conv.oscillating: The values do not approach monotonically, so the estimate uses a conservative safety factor of 3.
conv.chartLabel: Value against number of elements (dashed: extrapolated)
step.boundaries.hintExternal: Nothing to assign for flow around a body. Check the flow domain that is created for you.

share.noVideo: This browser cannot export video. Open Studio in Chrome, Edge or Firefox 130+

err.no_voltage: At least one fixed-potential face is required. Set a ground or a voltage.

redo.label: Redo

ai.selectionHint: Select faces in the viewport, then ask “fix the faces I selected”.
results.beforeUndo: Results are from before the undo. Run again.
struct.loadsIgnored: Modal analysis ignores loads and uses supports only.
struct.thermalFaces: Set each face’s thermal condition in Boundaries.
section.title: Section view
section.probe: Click the cut face to read its value.
line.title: Line plot
export.title: Result files
struct.follower: Pressure follows deformed faces. Other loads keep their original direction (dead loads).
struct.plasticSmall: J2 plasticity supports small strain. Turn large deformation off.
contact.title: Contacts
contact.touching: Touching faces only; parts must share a face after import. Select interfaces to edit them together.
template.press-fit.title: Press fit
template.press-fit.description: Lamé thick cylinders, plane stress. Contact pressure and ring hoop stress.
template.stacked-blocks.title: Stacked blocks
template.stacked-blocks.description: Uniform compression of two touching cubes; frictionless contact.
template.friction-block.title: Friction block
template.friction-block.description: Coulomb stick/slip under normal pressure and shear, with a soft spring. This patch uses Poisson ratio 0.
template.large-cantilever.title: Large cantilever
template.large-cantilever.description: Inextensible Euler elastica, PL²/EI = 1; compare with the linear answer. The beam clamp permits lateral strain.
template.plastic-bar.title: Plastic bar
template.plastic-bar.description: Uniaxial bilinear hardening: load to 1%, unload through zero force, then return to zero displacement.
template.plastic-beam-collapse.title: Plastic beam collapse
template.plastic-beam-collapse.descripti: Perfectly plastic rectangular cantilever; P = σy b h²/(4L), neglecting shear. A limit run ends without convergence. The beam clamp permits lateral strain.
template.rubber-tension.title: Rubber tension
template.rubber-tension.description: Homogeneous compressible neo-Hookean tension, λ = 2 and zero lateral stress.
struct.beamClampHelp: Holds section translation and rotation while permitting lateral strain. Used for classical beam references.
